content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-live-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-nowpayments-integration-static-site-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-5|Crypto Payment]]-3|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal promise ease of use and wide acceptance, but they come with significant limitations for creators in Nigeria. These platforms often restrict access, impose hefty fees, and can freeze accounts without notice, leading to lost sales and damaged reputation. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a robust, base-layer solution, giving creators full control over their store, payments, and customer data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have explicit restrictions for many countries, including Nigeria, severely limiting the ability of digital creators to sell their products globally. These restrictions are often due to regulatory compliance issues or perceived risk, but they disproportionately affect legitimate businesses. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, operates independently of these restrictions, providing a pathway for creators in restricted countries to participate in the global digital economy without being locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical factors for digital creators. Traditional platforms charge significant transaction fees, sometimes as high as 5-10%, and may hold payments for extended periods. In contrast, solutions like NOWPayments offer crypto payment processing with fees as low as 0.5%, and payments are confirmed on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and speed. This significantly reduces the cost of doing business and increases profitability for creators.
Sovereign infrastructure means owning your commerce stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure prioritizes ownership and automation, enabling creators to have full control over their digital products and sales process. With automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery, creators can focus on producing high-quality content rather than managing payments and logistics. This infrastructure also ensures that creators retain all customer data, enhancing their ability to build direct, lasting relationships with their audience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For digital creators in Nigeria and other restricted countries, choosing the right commerce architecture is crucial. While traditional platforms may seem convenient, their restrictions and fees can be debilitating. Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a permanent, structural alternative, providing creators with the tools they need to compete globally without compromise. By opting for a sovereign solution, creators can ensure their business's longevity and success, unencumbered by the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Crypto payments reduce fees and increase transaction speed.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose a backend logic solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, set up order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and test your store to ensure seamless transactions and product delivery.
